# Support

- **Bug in the app or self-hosting trouble?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/wakeupba/be/issues/new/choose).
- **Question about the hosted service, billing, or your account?** Use the contact options at [wakeupba.be](https://wakeupba.be), please don't put account details in public issues.
- **Security problem?** See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), never a public issue.
